inference_unit: base instance,24 newly generated development instances; seeds,budgets and replays are within-instance repeats
primary_comparison: PyVRP vs multistart VND separately at each CPU ceiling; 24 base-instance means over3seeds
secondary_comparison: VND vs savings and1s vs0.25s within each method; all descriptive development
freeze_rule: freeze all source, protocol, manifest and input hashes before first batch solver call
stop_rule: 432 primary calls once, then432 complete-output replay calls; preserve all failures and timing divergences

purpose: Fresh development scale/budget study; increased work limits and common margin make this a new configuration, not one-factor comparison to previous runs
